paite: Nou Bashan bawngpite, Samaria tang tung a om a, gentheite simmoh a, tasamte nuaisiah a, atoupate uh kiang a, "Hon la unla i dawn ding uh," chite aw, hiai thu za un;
heading: Israelte Tung A Vauhilhna
english: Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy, who tell their husbands, “Bring us drinks!”

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in ama sianthouna in akichiam a, "Ngai dih ua, sikkuaika a nou ahon lakmang a, na lak ua omsun ngakuai a ahon lakmang ni ahong tung ding hi.
english: The Lord Yahweh has sworn by his holiness, “Behold, the days shall come on you that they will take you away with hooks, and the last of you with fish hooks.

paite: Huan awngvang ah na paisuak ding ua, michih tangtak in apai ding uh; Harmon ah paih in na om ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: You will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her; and you will cast yourselves into Harmon,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Bethel ah hong unla, talek un; Gilgal ah hong unla, tatlekna pungsak un; huan, na kithoihnate uh zingsang teng in hon la unla, ni khat hal zel in na sawm ua khatte uh hon la un.
heading: Israelte'n Biakna Limsak Lou
english: “Go to Bethel, and sin; to Gilgal, and sin more. Bring your sacrifices every morning, your tithes every three days,

paite: Huan silngou pang kipahthu gen kithoihna lan unla, amau deihdan a lante hilh unla, puang un; Aw Israel suante aw, hiai lah na deih ngal ua," Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
english: offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, and proclaim free will offerings and brag about them; for this pleases you, you children of Israel,” says the Lord Yahweh.

paite: "Huan ke'n leng na khopi tengteng uah hasianna leh na mun tengteng uah taksapna ka hon pia a; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in every town; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: “Buh lak hun ding kha thum ahih lai in na tung ua vuah zu ding leng ka len a; khopi khat tung ah ka zusak in, khopi dang tung ah ka zusak kei hi; mun khat tung ah ka zusak sek a, azuklouhna mun akeu hi.
english: “I also have withheld the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain on one city, and caused it not to rain on another city. One field was rained on, and the field where it didn’t rain withered.

paite: Huchi in khopi nih leh thum ah tui dawn ding zong in khopi dang ah ataikhawm ua, adeihkhop kei uh; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: So two or three cities staggered to one city to drink water, and were not satisfied; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Keuna leh apna in ka hon gawt a; na huante uh, na grephuante uh, na theipi kungte uh, na olive singkungte uh singnget lung in ane khin vekta hi; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I struck you with blight and mildew many times in your gardens and your vineyards, and the swarming locusts have devoured your fig trees and your olive trees; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Aigupta gam bang in na lak uah huihpi ka sawl a; namsau in na tangvalte uh ka that a, na sakolte uh ka pimang a; na giahphualte uh gim namsia na nak ua nam khop in ka hon omsak a; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I sent plagues among you like I did Egypt. I have slain your young men with the sword, and have carried away your horses. I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camp, yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: "Pathian in Sodom leh Gomorrah khua achipsak lai bang in, na lak uah mi khenkhat ka hihchim a, singkang lakkhiak bang na hi ua; huchi in leng ka kiang ah na hong kik kei uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: “I have overthrown some of you, as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire; yet you haven’t returned to me,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in "Aw Israel, na tung ah hichibang in ka hih ding; na tung a hiai ka hih ding ziak in, Aw Israel, na Pathian tuak ding in mansa in om in!"
english: “Therefore I will do this to you, Israel; because I will do this to you, prepare to meet your God, Israel.

paite: "Ngai in, tangte dingkhesak a, huih bawl a, mihing kiang a angaihtuahna bang ahia chih genkhesak a, zingsang mialsak, lei mun sangte chilpa amin TOUPA, sepaihte' Pathian ahi!"
english: For, behold, he who forms the mountains, creates the wind, declares to man what is his thought, who makes the morning darkness, and treads on the high places of the earth: Yahweh, the God of Armies, is his name.”
